description: Verify that TCP in CLOSED ignores a RST control message (RFC 793 §3.9 p65 Event Processing)
approach:
[Objective]
A RST arriving at a CLOSED port has no connection to abort. DUT must ignore it — emitting any response (RST, ACK) would let an attacker provoke traffic from an idle port.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in CLOSED.
2. Tester → DUT: RST.
3. Observation: DUT must NOT respond.

[Pass condition]
No DUT response to the RST.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_unexpected_response — DUT emitted any reply to RST in CLOSED

verdicts.Pass: DUT silently ignored RST in CLOSED — normal
verdicts.Fail_unexpected_response: DUT emitted response to RST in CLOSED
